# implement-spec ledger — P15.1 web shell + epistemic visual language

- **spec:** docs/tickets/P15.1__web-shell.md (canonical §§39.0, 39.1, 39.9, 40)
- **base commit:** cb2df2d9ff63f4ac75667d0140f247dd2d31f79b (P14.2 exports)
- **branch:** devin/p15-1-web-shell
- **base_branch:** devin/p14-2-exports (stacked chain)

## Operator decisions (Phase 0, recorded)
1. Data: **committed TS fixtures** in web/ mirroring the api envelope/demo shapes (no build-time API dependency; fully static).
2. Absence→task: hatch is a **GET link to a task-intake page** pre-filled with subject/predicate/absence-kind that renders the generated ResearchTask descriptor (no-JS friendly).
3. CI tools: **Playwright+axe (a11y), license-checker (OSI-only), Lighthouse CI (perf budgets)**.
4. Page scope: **component library + reference/demo pages** (landing shell + reference map/graph demos exercising every component). P15.2–P15.5 consume the components; do not build their surfaces.

## Requirements (from §§39.0/39.1/39.9/40 + ticket)
- SIG-UI-003 four-step support glyph + accessible text equiv + machine-readable evidence count + downgrade reason code
- SIG-UI-004 four epistemic fields (resolution_status/support/agreement/currency) independently visible; NO fused badge
- SIG-UI-005 no colour-only encoding; redundant glyph/texture/text channel on every epistemic state (WCAG 1.4.1)
- SIG-UI-006 saturated colour reserved for epistemic state/data; GREEN never for epistemic state
- SIG-UI-007 absence = exactly ONE texture (hatch); four absence kinds (§9.5) distinguishable within it; each clickable → generates a research task
- SIG-UI-008 contested-value marker persistent at EVERY appearance (cell, tile, popup, API, export)
- SIG-UI-009 contradiction as value range with competing claims plotted (source/tier/date/link, different-quantity note) (§29.1)
- SIG-UI-035 belief-pinned permalink + "cite this page" affordance (as-of pair + ruleset version) on every page; reproducible after correction (SIG-TIME-008)
- SIG-UI-036 (SHOULD) zero-JS-by-default static-first framework, opt-in islands; archivability structural (greppable directive to break)
- SIG-UI-037 core content usable without JS; tabular equivalent per map; list equivalent per graph
- SIG-UI-039 every dependency OSI-licensed; exclude CC-BY-NC/source-available/dual-BUSL; checked in CI not memory
- SIG-UI-041 performance budgets enforced in CI; build fails on regression

## Reference: the four epistemic fields (§10.7) & four absence kinds (§9.5)
- fields: resolution_status(RESOLVED|UNRESOLVED|SUPERSEDED|WITHDRAWN); support(CONFIRMED|STRONGLY_SUPPORTED|PROBABLE|WEAKLY_SUPPORTED|UNSUPPORTED); agreement(UNCONTESTED|MINOR_DISAGREEMENT|CONTESTED|IRRECONCILABLE); currency(CURRENT|AGING|STALE|HISTORICAL)
- support glyph 4-step e.g. ⊕⊕⊕◯
- absence kinds: NOT_RESEARCHED, NO_EVIDENCE_FOUND, EVIDENCE_OF_ABSENCE, UNRESOLVED

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1 core usable without JS; reference map has tabular equiv, reference graph has list equiv (deterministic)
- AC2 WCAG 2.2 AA automated checks pass; no colour-only encoding anywhere (deterministic)
- AC3 four epistemic fields independently visible; no fused badge emitted (deterministic)
- AC4 absence = exactly one texture, clickable, generating a research task works end-to-end (agentic)
- AC5 contested values marked at every appearance (cell/tile/popup/API-backed view/export) — across render paths (deterministic)
- AC6 every page: belief-pinned permalink + citation affordance; citation today re-resolves to same belief after correction (deterministic)
- AC7 phase-gate §51.3: CI green incl data-quality; new reqs have automated tests (SIG-ENG-004); ADRs for deviations; traceability updated; risk-register Phase 15 updated

## Out of scope (scope-creep guard)
- local dossier + print/PDF path — P15.2
- infrastructure map, self-hosted PMTiles, network explorer — P15.3
- procurement/renewal watch, evidence recommender/viewer — P15.4
- research queue, corrections log, methodology/coverage pages, editorial standards — P15.5
- read API + exports — P14.1/P14.2 (merged)

## Dependency map (reuse, do not reinvent)
- envelope shape: api/src/api/models.py ResolutionEnvelope (value, resolution_status, support, agreement, currency, rationale{code,text}, supporting/dissenting_claim_ids, as_of_world/belief, ruleset_version, contradiction_state...)
- as-of echo: AsOfEcho (as_of_world, as_of_belief, belief_pinned, question)
- coverage: CoverageStatement + CoverageRecord.public_view (absence_kind)
- demo data: api/src/api/demo.py (OKCPD 42 vs 38 device-count contradiction, sealed capture, coverage gap)
- absence kinds enum: §9.5 SIG-TIME-010
- research task shape: tasks/src/tasks/lifecycle.py ResearchTask, tasks/vocabulary.py TaskStatus

## Phase 1 plan + test matrix
Pinned deps (all ≥7d old): astro@7.2.4, typescript@5.9.3, @astrojs/check@0.9.10, vitest@4.1.11,
@playwright/test@1.62.1, @axe-core/playwright@4.13.0, license-checker-rseidelsohn@5.0.1, @lhci/cli@0.15.1.

Structure under web/:
- src/lib/epistemic.ts (types mirroring api envelope; glyph/field/absence/contested/contradiction pure logic)
- src/lib/fixtures.ts (committed fixtures mirroring api/demo.py OKCPD 42-vs-38)
- src/lib/task.ts (research-task descriptor from absence params; mirrors tasks vocabulary/lifecycle)
- src/lib/citation.ts (belief-pinned permalink + citation string builder)
- src/components/{SupportGlyph,EpistemicFields,AbsenceHatch,ContestedMarker,ContradictionRange,Citation,ReferenceMap,ReferenceGraph}.astro
- src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro (Citation on every page, skip-link, lang, no-JS)
- src/styles/epistemic.css (design tokens; hatch texture; NO green for epistemic state)
- src/pages/{index,visual-language,reference-map,reference-graph}.astro + src/pages/task/new.astro
- tests/unit/*.test.ts (vitest) ; tests/e2e/*.spec.ts (playwright+axe) ; lighthouserc.json ; scripts/check-licenses.mjs

Test matrix (AC → test):
- AC1 no-JS: e2e loads built HTML with JS disabled, asserts map's tabular equiv + graph's list equiv present & populated
- AC2 WCAG2.2AA: axe scan every page (wcag2a,wcag2aa,wcag22aa) 0 violations; unit test: no epistemic token maps to a green hue; no colour-only (redundant text/glyph channel asserted per state)
- AC3 four fields independent: unit test EpistemicFields renders 4 labelled fields, no single fused token; e2e asserts 4 distinct field elements + absence of data-fused
- AC4 absence: unit test one hatch class for all; four kinds distinguishable (distinct data-absence-kind + text); task.ts generates valid ResearchTask (status generated, subject/predicate/absence_kind); e2e clicks hatch → /task/new renders generated task descriptor
- AC5 contested marker: unit test contested value marked in cell/tile/popup/list render helpers; e2e asserts marker present in table cell + map popup + graph list
- AC6 citation: unit test citation builder embeds as_of_world/belief + ruleset_version + belief-pinned permalink; reproducibility test: same belief re-resolves same value after appended correction fixture; e2e asserts permalink+cite on every page
- perf: lighthouse budgets (performance assertions, resource-size) fail build on regression
- licenses: check-licenses.mjs fails on any non-OSI / CC-BY-NC / source-available / dual-BUSL dep
